scope: Deployed observation assessment on 480 independent synthetic cases including simultaneous faults; executed-action checks are model-consistency tests.

protocol.training: First 70 healthy rows; fit eligibility checked before use. Otherwise defaults remain labelled assumptions. CUSUM bias uses the first 60 assumed-healthy minutes; instrument noise uses the first 60 samples. Post-gap windows are never relabelled as healthy commissioning.
protocol.targets: Separate reported hot-spot and observed-oil targets. True synthetic target errors are also reported for scoring only; no hidden temperatures enter assessment.
protocol.inputs: Observed voltage, loading, oil, reported hot-spot and ambient only. No scenario, cooling, fault label, future row or true plant parameter.
protocol.limits: Two synthetic plant families, overlapping origins and paired seeds; these are not independent field assets. Event onset varies from minute 90 to 115. Primary MAE retains every eligible window including future disturbances. Disjoint timing partitions expose that distinction. Cases withheld for model discrepancy remain in coverage denominators. Combined-case detection requires all expected signals concurrently. v3 development reuses 3101–3112; fresh evaluation uses 91001–91024. v2 seeds 88001–88024 are now historical regressions. Threshold-only comparison uses identical validity gates with CUSUM disabled. No field validation, calibrated confidence or failure probability.
